title: Davis uses DIA deputization to get access to the crash retrieval program

tellings.quote: using my security clearances my need to know my access including my letter that I'm deputized by Jim Lowsky as a representative of the of the Defense Intelligence Agency. I used all that leverage and authority to get into the crash retrieval program. I couldn't get access to CCraft bodies or talk to the people, but I was able to get in to the people who handled all of that at a programmatic level and got confirmation that all of that was real, that all of it happened.

plain: The physicist Eric W. Davis says he used his security clearances and a letter making him a representative of the Defense Intelligence Agency, the Pentagon's military intelligence arm, signed by the agency official Jim Lacatski, to get into a secret programme that recovers crashed UFOs. He tells Michels he "couldn't get access to craft, bodies or talk to the people", but reached those who ran it "at a programmatic level" and "got confirmation that all of that was real, that all of it happened". If true, it means a cleared government scientist confirmed from the inside that such a programme exists.
